question: The largest possible cone is carved from a solid wooden cube of side 21 cm. What is the volume of the wood (in cm³) left over? (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of cube (a) = 21 cm

For the largest cone: Radius (r) = a/2 = 10.5 cm, Height (h) = a = 21 cm

Volume of cube = a³ = 21³ = 9261 cm³

Volume of cone = (1/12) × π × a³ = (11/42) × 9261 = 2425.5 cm³

Leftover wood = 9261 − 2425.5 = 6835.5 cm³

**∴ Answer = 6835.5**
